subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.

The way Sheetal __imparts __knowledge to her students is really praiseworthy.
solution:
The correct answer is **transmits**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence is transmits (कुछ पारित करना, संचारित).
 
• The way Sheetal transmits __knowledge to her students is really praiseworthy.
 
• 
 
The word "**imparts**" (प्रदान करना) means to convey or communicate information or knowledge to someone. "**Transmits**" is a suitable synonym in this context as it also means to pass or communicate something to others.

 
 
• 
 
**The synonym of imparts is transmits. **

 Therefore, option 2 is the correct option.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

 
• **Discloses**: It means to reveal, make known, or uncover information or a secret. (कुछ प्रकट करना)
 
• **Transmits**: It means to pass or convey something from one person or place to another, such as information, knowledge, or signals. (कुछ पारित करना, संचारित)
 
• **Exposes**: It means to make something visible, reveal, or subject something or someone to a situation or experience. (कुछ प्रकट करना)
 
• **Admits**: It has multiple meanings depending on the context. In the sense of acknowledging or confessing, it means to accept or confess something, usually a truth or wrongdoing. In the sense of granting access or permission, it means to allow entry or permit someone to enter or use something. (स्वीकार करते हैं)
